description:
Imagine what you could do at Apple! Everyday, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Do you bring passion and dedication to your job? If so, we are looking for individuals like you. The Apple Media Graphics & Compute (MGC) group is at the center of audio, video, and graphics in Apple’s innovative products, including the iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, AirPods, HomePod, Apple TV and VisionPro. 

Description
MGC’s Audio team provides the audio foundation for various high profile features like Game Audio, Siri, FaceTime, media capture, playback and API’s for third party developers to enrich our platforms. The team is looking for talented engineers who are passionate about building audio features and products for millions of customers and care about overall user experience. You will revolutionize the audio experience for game and future audio technologies.

Responsibilities
You are a team-oriented professional with excellent interpersonal skills and are comfortable in a fast-paced environment. 
You will be responsible for continually improving the performance of the audio stack by conducting investigations using a variety of performance tools, proposing optimizations and improvements and also working with other multi-functional teams in an effort to realize higher levels of performance across the overall system. 
The ideal candidate has in-depth experience in systems-level programming and writing multi-threaded C++ code.

Minimum qualifications
5+ years experience with software development
Strong coding skills in C++ or SWIFT
Experience with and understanding of real-time multithreaded programming systems
Knowledge of memory and compute performance analysis and characterization
Experience using various performance tracing, profiling and logging tools is highly desired

Preferred qualifications
Experience with audio technologies is a plus
Experience leading or mentoring a team of resourceful engineers is a plus.
